subsection.title: User and Starting Context
subsection.description: Identify the user, the situation they are in, what they already have, and what starts the journey.

subsection.title: Main Flow
subsection.description: - Describe one representative flow in three to eight steps. - For each step, state the user action, product response, and expected result.
subsection.example: | Step | User action | Product response | Expected result | |------|-------------|------------------|-----------------| | 1 | Starts a new idea | Asks the first focused question | The user understands what to provide |

subsection.title: Completion Result
subsection.description: State what the user can see, use, share, or decide when the scenario is complete.

subsection.title: Key Interruptions
subsection.description: Optional. Describe at most two interruptions only when they materially change what the PoC must demonstrate.
